posts.author: aghisays
posts.content_md:
Not sure if this is the right area for this but Google's online library project is in beta. If you go to google, type: book holography, you get the online complete version of three holography books. Hopefully this list will grow with time.

Of course, you can try different searches and get all kind of titles.

You can read more about it at

[http://print.google.com/](http://print.google.com/)

posts.author: HoloM
posts.content_md: Couldn't find them. Could you please post the direct links to these three books?

posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
HoloM, Just type in "book holography" in a regular google page and you will see as the first entry at the top of the list the three books. 

Here it the Google search.

[http://www.google.com/search?hl=en&lr=& ... tnG=Search](http://www.google.com/search?hl=en&lr=&safe=off&q=book+holography&btnG=Search)

The books are;

Book results for holography 

Electron Holography - by A Tonomura - 176 pages

Particle Field Holography - by Chandra S Vikram - 265 pages

Lasers and Holography - by Winston E Kock - 160 pages

posts.author: JohnFlux
posts.content_md: The online books aren't complete - only the first 15 pages or so.

posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md: No, the books **are** complete but because of copyright restrictions you can only see a few pages at a time. Multiple searches will show you more pages.
